title: Expectation of a convolution of densities
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\psi$ and $\phi$ be probability densities on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ (nonnegative functions with uniform expectation one), and let $F:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{R}$. The expectation of $F$ with respect to the convolution of $\psi$ and $\phi$ equals the expectation of the convolution of $\phi$ with $F$ with respect to $\psi$.
hypotheses_covered: $\psi$ is a nonnegative probability density of uniform expectation one
$\phi$ is a nonnegative probability density of uniform expectation one
